titulo: Say how long you have before you start
caption:
Say how long you have before you start

Before the chat starts, Cella says how long she has: twenty minutes. Then she gives all twenty.

For whoever says how long they have before they start.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background in a lavender room. At the top, the words: 20 minutes. For whoever says how long they have before they start. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes stands to the left and a second small figure of another color stands to the right. The words appear one line at a time: before we start. I say how long (a bubble that says 20 minutes). Twenty minutes (a round timer with a yellow light pops up between them). All of it is yours (a bubble that says all yours, the second figure smiles, a star appears). The closing line: for whoever says how long they have. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella said how long she had before she started. Somebody got all of it.
evolucion: Tres apuestas (junta-ene-s2, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. Hora (apuesta 3a): los Shorts de las 23:00Z contra los de 17:00Z de la misma semana.
